answer: A vertex on file, a lantern already paid, and a cipher that outlives the epoch: that is what the checker wants. Before any reward, the agent must show Ancient butcher licence with butchers attestation — a licence butchers renew after meat audits. The price is time: 4 years and 150 meat audits per identity, and time is the one thing a farm cannot print. A faker would have to earn all three from scratch.
